memory_candidates.content: In a Lean modal-logic proof library, a representation-agnostic typeclass consumption layer (HasAxiom* bundled into ModalHilbert/ModalS4Hilbert/... via extends) plus a predicate-parametric derivation type (DerivationTree over Axioms : Proposition -> Prop) makes a compositional set-of-schemata combinator (SchemaUnion (S : Finset Tag)) feasible with a NET-LINE-NEGATIVE, INSULATED blast radius: per-system soundness case-splits and hand-written O(edges) subsumption lemmas are DELETED (replaced by one generic unionSound + Finset.subset facts), while completeness/conservativity/lifting are untouched because they route through the typeclass fields rather than the inductive's constructors. The irreducible hand cost is the file doing genuine cross-family derivation work (intuitionistic->classical), not the raw destructuring-site count. Staged additive rollout (introduce combinator alongside inductives with bridge equivalences, migrate consumers one file at a time, delete inductives last) keeps every intermediate commit CI-green and zero-debt.

In Lean 4, an existential over a formula-metavariable followed by dot-notation field projection on that bound variable in the equation body (e.g. `∃ φ ψ, χ = φ.imp (ψ.imp φ)`) fails to elaborate with 'Invalid field notation: Type of φ is not known' because dot notation needs the bound variable's type resolved before the body is elaborated, and Lean does not backward-infer it from the later `χ = ...` equation. Fix: add an explicit type ascription on the existential binder, e.g. `∃ φ ψ : Proposition Atom, χ = φ.imp (ψ.imp φ)`.
